report.summary: Section 7 makes 9 distinct claims, none of which define the 'typed MissionContract' schema, artifact DAG format, recipe versioning scheme, or evidence packet structure, forcing implementers to invent critical definitions.
risks: 7.1 | high | 'Ikarus is persistent in goals and evidence' assumes persistence mechanism and goal representation undefined; implementer must guess storage and goal format | require explicit persistence backend and goal schema
7.2 | high | 'compiles user intent into a typed MissionContract' assumes existence of intent parsing and contract schema; neither defined | define MissionContract type and intent-to-contract mapping
7.3 | high | 'creates an artifact DAG' assumes DAG representation and constraints (acyclic, node types) undefined | specify artifact DAG data model

7.4 | high | 'selects stateless or explicitly versioned recipes' assumes recipe registry and versioning convention undefined; 'stateless' vs 'versioned' ambiguity | define recipe repository interface and versioning policy
7.5 | medium | 'monitors budgets and attempts' assumes budget metric and attempt lifecycle undefined; failure modes not described | define budget units, attempt states, and monitoring hooks
7.6 | medium | 'presents decisions and evidence' assumes presentation format and evidence provenance undefined | specify evidence packet schema and presentation interface

7.7 | high | 'Coordination is artifact-first' with pipeline arrow assumes pipeline stages and artifact passing semantics undefined; missing failure handling for each stage | define WorkItems, Attempts, Artifacts, EvidencePacket types and transition rules

7.8 | high | 'Typed events and artifacts are authoritative. Chat is an interface, not the workflow database.' assumes event schema and artifact type system undefined; authority enforcement mechanism missing | define event type registry and artifact type hierarchy

7.9 | high | 'Product memory and research adaptive memory are separate, versioned, provenance-bearing stores with explicit projection rules' assumes projection rules and provenance metadata undefined; versioning scheme missing | define projection rule language, provenance record format, and versioning strategy
todos: Define the typed MissionContract schema (fields, types, constraints).
Define the artifact DAG data model (node types, edge semantics, acyclicity).
Define recipe registry interface and versioning policy (stateless vs. versioned).
Define budget metric, attempt lifecycle states, and monitoring hooks.
Define evidence packet schema and presentation interface.
Define WorkItems, Attempts, Artifacts, EvidencePacket types and transition rules.
Define event type registry and artifact type hierarchy.
Define projection rule language, provenance record format, and versioning strategy for memory stores.
Define persistence backend and goal representation for Ikarus persistence claim.

claims.claim: Ikarus is persistent in goals and evidence, not an unconstrained immortal chat.
claims.why: Claim asserts persistence but does not define the persistence mechanism (storage backend, serialization format) or the representation of goals and evidence. Implementer must guess how goals are stored and retrieved.

claims.claim: It compiles user intent into a typed MissionContract.
claims.why: Claim assumes a 'typed MissionContract' exists but does not specify its type schema, fields, or constraints. Also, 'compiles user intent' implies a parsing/compilation step with undefined input format and error handling. Missing: intent grammar, contract type definition.
Claim asserts creation of a DAG of artifacts but does not define the node types, edge semantics, or DAG constraints (acyclicity, ordering). Missing: DAG data model and API.

claims.claim: selects stateless or explicitly versioned recipes
claims.why: Claim assumes a recipe registry with two versioning modes but does not define 'stateless' vs 'explicitly versioned' semantics, recipe schema, or selection criteria. Missing: recipe type, versioning convention, selection algorithm.

Claim asserts monitoring of budgets and attempts but does not define budget metric (time, cost, iterations), attempt lifecycle, or monitoring hooks. Missing: budget units, attempt states, monitoring interface.
Claim asserts presentation of decisions and evidence but does not define evidence packet structure or presentation format (UI, API). Missing: evidence schema, presentation interface.

claims.claim: Coordination is artifact-first: MissionContract -> WorkItems -> Attempts -> Artifacts -> EvidencePacket
claims.why: Claim defines a pipeline but does not define any of the intermediate types (WorkItems, Attempts, EvidencePacket) or transition rules. Missing: type definitions, transition semantics, failure handling at each stage.

claims.claim: Typed events and artifacts are authoritative. Chat is an interface, not the workflow database.
claims.why: Claim asserts authority of typed events and artifacts but does not define event types, artifact type system, or enforcement mechanism (how is authority ensured?). Missing: event type registry, artifact type hierarchy, authority enforcement.

claims.claim: Product memory (preferences, projects, explanations) and research adaptive memory (operators, priors, trial outcomes) are separate, versioned, provenance-bearing stores with explicit projection rules.
claims.why: Claim asserts separate versioned stores with provenance and projection rules but does not define projection rule language, provenance metadata format, or versioning strategy. Missing: projection rule specification, provenance record schema, versioning policy.
